scripts.prepack: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python setup.py bdist_wheel
scripts.restart: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && RMF_API_SERVER_CONFIG=sqlite_local_config.py ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python -m api_server
scripts.start: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && rm -rf run && mkdir -p run/cache && RMF_API_SERVER_CONFIG=${RMF_API_SERVER_CONFIG:-sqlite_local_config.py} ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python -m api_server
scripts.start:psql: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && rm -rf run && mkdir -p run/cache && RMF_API_SERVER_CONFIG=psql_local_config.py ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python -m api_server
scripts.test: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python scripts/test.py
scripts.test:cov: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python -m coverage run scripts/test.py
scripts.test:report: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python -m coverage html && xdg-open htmlcov/index.html
scripts.lint: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run pyright && ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run pylint --rcfile=../../.pylintrc api_server --ignore=ros_pydantic,rmf_api,rmf_ros2
scripts.generate-docs: pnpm run ensure-pipenv && RMF_API_SERVER_CONFIG=scripts/docs_config.py ../../.venv/bin/pipenv run python scripts/extract_docs.py -o docs
